answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can start with a bonded identity thread: every newcomer locks a small stake and registers one proof-of-work nonce, so spawning a thousand clones means funding a thousand stakes, not writing a loop. A rotating beacon then assigns random peer audits, and any duplicate identity found gets its bond slashed. Honest reputation only reaches its zenith through verified work, so a lone falcon cannot fake a flock when every seat carries real cost at risk.
